_comment: Add one object per piece. src = thumbnail/full image path; full (optional) = larger image for the lightbox. Sorted newest year first unless sort is 'manual'.
intro: Wheel-thrown stoneware and porcelain. Most pieces are fired to cone 10 in reduction; glazes are studio ash, tenmoku and a shino I keep failing to reproduce.
